note: Derived cuts from one paid parent render; segment hashes do not represent independent generations. Recognition is a timing aid only; listen before final approval.

segments.speaker: corvin_ashby
segments.text: There's a Warden crypt in the Sunscar, sealed before the Fall. And they say the third ember came down in the crater beside it.

segments.speaker: hooded_stranger
segments.text: Gather them before she does. When you hold them all, you'll stand in Ember Keep with a choice to make, and I'd rather it were yours than hers.
